settings.question: What makes the authentic Grill Rescue different?
settings.answer: It is the original firefighter-designed, patented bristle-free brush and scraper, engineered as a complete steam-cleaning system with official replacement parts and Grill Rescue support.

settings.question: Does Grill Rescue use wire bristles?
settings.answer: No. Grill Rescue uses a bristle-free premium aramid-fiber cleaning head.

settings.question: Can I replace and clean the head?
settings.answer: Yes. The cleaning head is replaceable and dishwasher friendly. Follow the care instructions included with your product.

settings.question: How can I make sure I am buying the real product?
settings.answer: Purchase directly from Grill Rescue or an authorized seller, and compare the product branding, construction, packaging, and seller information with the authenticity details shown on this page.

settings.question: Is the authentic brush covered by a guarantee?
settings.answer: Grill Rescue currently promotes a 30-day guarantee on its site. Update this answer if your campaign terms change.
